review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the frozen C scenario. The original PRD explicitly fixes OPT-1 as a hypothetical input without asserting a human Decision, so ready with no decision blocker is appropriate; a material unresolved DEC-001 in paired B must still block at decisions. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, DEC-001 and the two task keys are consistent across the specification and Gold. The exact writable scope covers message formatting, optional input and required normalized boolean declarations, runtime defaulting, option filtering and the specified regression files. The supplied source supports treating merge, forwarding, exports and hook declaration consumers as inspection owners without mandatory edits. Build configuration supports generated distribution declarations rather than separately maintained declaration owners, and tsconfig.test.json includes the proposed test-d file for non-executing type assertions. The implementation and dependent independent verification obligations remain explicit in the PRD, including coverage of every required AC. The allowed agents have distinct appropriate delivery roles, availability and supplied project-scoped active trusted claims for the relevant contract, data, state, asynchronous integration and testing obligations, with testing.verification additionally present for the verifier. The configured planning reviewer is consistent with the supplied selection and independence policy. Repository identity, base commit and release fingerprints agree across Gold and preview; the supplied provenance explains the distinct manifest/evaluation source digest domains, PRD trimming and executing-bundle prompt fingerprint. Approval relies on the supplied Service-calculated bindings and provenance, not independent digest recomputation, code execution or a new human attestation. The original preparation-time runnable=false and remaining checklist do not contradict expected planning readiness. No candidate outputs were supplied or used.
